text: Are you ready to play a game?
It is called Beat the Beads!
I will spin the wheel, and it will land on a number.
You tell me that number's friend, before I count to three.
If the beads get stuck, you will know exactly what to do.
Let's find out who remembers best.
Round one — spin the wheel!
It lands on add one.
Make four, then try to add one more.
Look at that, we are stuck.
Quick — what is one's friend?
One's friend is four!
Four plus one is five!
Round two — spin the wheel!
It lands on take away three.
Make six, then try to take away three.
Uh oh, we are stuck again.
Think fast — what is three's friend?
Three's friend is two!
Six take away three is three!
Round three — spin the wheel!
It lands on add four.
Make one, then try to add four more.
Stuck already?
Let's fix that.
Here it comes — what is four's friend?
Four's friend is one!
One plus four is five!
Round four — spin the wheel!
It lands on take away two.
Make six, then try to take away two.
There it is — stuck once more.
Can you get this one?
What is two's friend?
Two's friend is three!
Six take away two is four!
Four down, four to go — you are on fire today!
If you are having fun, tap that like button.
The wheel keeps mixing it up — you never know what is coming next!
Round five — spin the wheel!
It lands on take away one.
Make five, then try to take away one.
We are stuck, but we know exactly what to do.
You know this one — what is one's friend?
One's friend is four!
Five take away one is four!
Round six — spin the wheel!
It lands on add three.
Make two, then try to add three more.
Stuck!
Lucky for us, we have a trick.
What is three's friend?
Tell me!
Three's friend is two!
Two plus three is five!
Round seven — spin the wheel!
It lands on take away four.
Make seven, then try to take away four.
Here we go again — stuck!
You know this one too — what is four's friend?
Four's friend is one!
Seven take away four is three!
Round eight — spin the wheel!
It lands on add two.
Make three, then try to add two more.
One more stuck moment to solve.
Last one — what is two's friend?
Two's friend is three!
Three plus two is five!
You just beat all eight small friends!
Four for adding, and four for taking away.
That is every small friend there is.
Try Beat the Beads on your own abacus at home.
For more sums to practice, search for Abacus Kids on the Apple App Store or Google Play.
Download it free.
Next time, we will meet a brand new kind of friend — the Big Friends of ten.
See you next time!
